## Paypal

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/paypal/overview): Braintree offers a few options when accepting PayPal payments. Choose whether you would like to use our Drop-in UI or a custom integration.
- [Migrating from checkout.js to the PayPal JS SDK](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/paypal/paypal-sdk-migration-guide/): This page is only relevant for JavaScript v3 PayPal custom integrations (not Drop-in UI).
